mechanism: Diltiazem may potentiate warfarin effects by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism, and vitamin K antagonizes warfarin's anticoagulant action, creating opposing therapeutic effects that complicate INR control.
action: Monitor INR closely if vitamin K supplementation is initiated or discontinued in patients on diltiazem and warfarin; maintain consistent vitamin K intake and adjust warfarin dosing as needed.
